summary_1line: Dialogue explains subtle speech, breath dynamics, and the distinct roles of senses, mind, and understanding as separate perceivers.

image_candidates.scene_text: The goddess Word sinks into Apana and rises again with Prana, flowing through the body like breath before spreading through the quarters.
Seven subtle priests—the nose, eye, tongue, skin, ear, mind, and understanding—stand apart in a vast inner space, unable to perceive one another.
The senses confront the proud Mind in debate, each asserting its power over colors, sounds, smells, tastes, and touch.
